cells.name: Watchtower
cells.description: A perimeter lookout tower: a sandbagged platform on legs, cabin, searchlight, ladder.

cells.name: Saluting base
cells.description: The low reviewing dais at the head of the parade square.

cells.name: Flag mast
cells.description: A tall flag mast and plain pennant, with its long shadow.

cells.name: Parade line
cells.description: A painted line along the middle of its row; runs join end to end.

cells.name: Parade corner
cells.description: The painted border's corner: lines along the middle of its north row and west column, open to the south and east.

cells.name: Parade ranks
cells.description: A dashed rank line marking where a file stands; runs join end to end.

cells.name: Parade centre
cells.description: The square's painted centre mark: a cross in a ring.
